Name: Mack
Description: Mack is a handsome full bred 2.5yr old boy (51lbs.) but sadly without certification. Mack is an extremely loving and playful pup who has high intense energy! He is great around children and loves to be with his pack. He would need a home familiar with the breed or similar breeds. As well as an outdoor loving owner/family to work him and his energy out. He loves to smell any and all things while going on walks. He is accustomed to a prong collar while on walks, has mental stimulation feeders, and knows basic commands (sit, stay, come, drop it, okay/release command, lay down, get back, get down). He is also great with other dogs, loves the dog parks and a good trail walk/run. Rehoming has been a difficult decision for us but we know with the right family and commitment he will thrive!

Name: Kingsley
Description: Kingsley is a 5 yr old pure bred welsh corgi. He loves walks and tug of war. He plays well with adults but does not do well with children. He can take sometime to warm up to people and is a very stubborn corgi. He knows basic commands like come sit stay and a few tricks. Potty trained and crate trained. Does not do well with other dogs. Great dog for a couple or single with no kids and plenty of time to play, etc with him. We are surrendering him for adoption due to aggression with our young children. He was a great dog before kids

Name: Gwen
Description: is a good dog that just needs some work. She does pull when on the leash but easily corrects herself. She is crate trained and has a crate. She is good with our children from toddlers to adults. She is on alert when new people come into the home but quickly realizes they are okay if we are okay with them here. She doesn't realize her size and has gotten the toddlers with her tail or knocked them over. She is very good with our indoor cat but does want to chase after the outdoor ones. She is good with our yorkie and my son's German shepherd mix(one male one female) but hasn't had exposure with us to any other dogs outside of that. Starting her vaccine series and gave a flea treatment when she arrived. She does have some hot spots and a wound that is healing where her collar sat. She is very good for a bath. She is not approved on our fostering license and had come to us after already ingredients getting our license. We now have 3 foster children under this license and cannot risk them being removed. She was a puppy from the 2nd of our 2 litters and we have a no questions asked return policy. We do have community connections and thought we could get her into a friend's home quickly but that fell through. Adoption fee is only for her care while she is with us.

Name: Lucy
Description: MEDICAL DEADLINE: LUCY WILL BE KILLED AT 2PM ON 3/4/26. Rescue Placement Only. #A590364 Lucy is a 2-year-old white and black Siberian Husky, listed at just 34 lbs on intake (later recorded at 40 lbs (likely an error). She was found and kept safe for 24 hours by a kind finder who wanted to help, but due to living arrangements, she couldn't keep her any longer. Now Lucy is out of time! Medical Emergency: Her top and bottom eyelids are curling inward more than normal- a painful condition causing irritation. There is discharge from her left eye. She needs medical care and relief, not a death sentence. This condition is treatable, but she needs a rescue to step up. Despite her discomfort, Lucy is described as FRIENDLY and APPROACHABLE. Even while in pain, she is gentle. She trusts. She leans in. She does not understand what is happening to her. She is not aggressive. She is not beyond help. She is simply in need of medical care. And for that, she is scheduled to die. DEADLINE: 2PM ON 3/4/26. There is almost no time. Lucy cannot walk herself out. She cannot ask for help. She only has us. CAN YOU FOSTER? CAN YOU ADOPT THROUGH A RESCUE? ARE YOU A RESCUE WHO CAN SAVE HER? Please share immediately. Tag rescues. Pledge if you can. Visibility saves lives. She deserves treatment. She deserves comfort. She deserves tomorrow. PET CONNECT LINK (for most up-to-date status): https://24Petconnect.com/DetailsMain/SBCT/A590364 PLEASE HELP LUCY. SHARE to show you CARE. Let's not let her story end at 2PM tomorrow. She's at the San Bernardino Shelter- one of the worse kill shelters around.

Name: Mei Mei
Description: Rescued after being dumped in Hesperia, CA, she was found playing with a mastiff who was out there, and she gets along with other dogs, children, and people of all ages. She is good on leash, loves to play, is under two years of age and above one year... She is super sweet, and loves TLC.

Name: Nora
Description: Rescued from the desert near Phelan, CA, this beautiful girl loves TLC, actually hangs out with chickens, rolls over for belly rubs, and is only 4 months old [3/3/26]. Her mother is part of a small pack of dumped dogs in the area, and we're working on getting all of them. She is scheduled for spay and rabies on 3/22, but could be adopted earlier under the proper circumstances. She has met cats and isn't sure what to think - to play or chase... The problem is her hold at her present location stops the first week of April, so if you're looking for a sweet girl and want to save a life, here's your chance.

Name: Bluey
Description: Bluey is 8 1/2 weeks old and has two vaccinations as of 3/3/26. He is a wonderful mix, but his mom is a Mal/GSD. He is super sweet, learning basic commands, takes treats nicely, and loves people of all ages. He is in Victorville, CA but can travel in the West. His mom was dumped and left for dead, and we rescued her and then her little ones came shortly after.

Name: Violet
Description: Violet is 8 1/2 weeks old and has two vaccinations as of 3/3/26. She is a cute mix, but her mom is a Mal/GSD. Violet has one health issue, and apparently on day 1 of her life one her siblings mistook her female parts for a place to nurse and did her some damage there. It was stitched and fixed, but mom thought she needed to help out, so she had to get fixed up again on day 2.  Since then she has urinated properly and well, but she might need some corrective work done at some point if a problem arises. She is super sweet, learning basic commands, takes treats nicely, and loves people of all ages. She is in Victorville, CA but can travel in the West. Her mom was dumped and left for dead, and we rescued her and then her little ones came shortly after.

Name: Ozu
Description: Ozu is a very loving guard dog that is loyal to his family and always makes sure the house is safe. He enjoys releasing his energy by walking, running around, and playing with his toys. His favorite toys are ones with squeakers and balls, and he loves chewing bones. Ozu would thrive with a younger, active couple that could take him on walks regularly and socialize him more. He is good at dog day care with supervision, but sometimes he struggles at dog parks. He'd do best in a home with a yard.  Ozu is trained to follow basic commands, and is able to get along with dog walkers and trainers. However, he can be on edge around males he hasn't met before. Once he gets to trust them, he becomes very sweet. We're also not sure how he'd do around large crowds. He is neutered, up-to-date on vaccinations and dental care, microchipped, and does not have any food allergies. He is a very sweet boy with a big heart!

Name: LANA
Description: Lana is our sweet girl between 2 & 3 years old and weighs 55lbs, she's a tall and lean girl. We rescued her when she was pregnant and now that she's had her babies and has been a sweet and loving mom to her puppies, so now she's ready to find her forever home. Lana has amber colored eyes, a beautiful long haired white coat and an amazing poofy tail. She's got a very sweet personality and she loves people and dogs. she's chill and calm making her ideal for every family.  She'll truly melt your and become your best friend. Lana is chipped, vaccinated and spayed, she only needs 1 more thing....YOU! Get your application in ASAP so you can meet Lana and fall in love!

Name: SNOW
Description: Meet our pretty 2yr old girl Snow. She's 46lbs but looks smaller than she is. We rescued her when she was pregnant and has been an amazing mom but now it's her turn to find her forever home. She's truly a sweet girl, loves people and dogs and has a kind personality. She has a beautiful coat and adorable chocolate drop eyes and she loves her toys and treats. She would be a fun girl to train too! She's definitely the kind of dog that will steal your heart! She's been chipped, vaccinated and spayed so she's ready and waiting for you! Get your application in ASAP for a chance to meet our pretty girl Snow!

Name: Conquer
Description: Conquer, the comeback kid, needs a home asap! He is a lovable dog, but also has special needs, so he needs a wonderful person to foster or adopt him. The rescue covers his medical care! Here is what his foster has to say about him: 'Conquer is a 12 year old, 30lb Pitbull/Shar-Pei mix ... Having survived a past of severe neglect, he is now a social, intelligent, and communicative gentleman looking for a home to live the best of the rest of his life. ��%BD%A0When we rescued Conquer in October 2025, he was dangerously underweight and suffering from severe skin irritation. Today, his transformation is nothing short of miraculous. While he has very few teeth left from his journey, he has gained a velvety, soft coat and a 'dinner prance' that will melt your heart. Conquer is a true extrovert! He currently lives with other dogs, but the gang do not always get along. He has been learning tricks like 'Touch,' is working on 'Shake,' and thrives with clicker training and durable puzzle toys. Because of his history of severe allergies and neglect, Conquer has developed some habits that require a little extra management: He thrives on a specific diet, daily Apoquel, and weekly medicated baths (where he'll sweetly rest his head on your leg). To prevent him from obsessively chewing/licking his groin area (a habit from his days of discomfort), Conquer wears male doggie diapers (belly bands) while indoors. He handles his 'outfits' like a pro, and it's a small trade-off for such a wonderful companion. ��%BD%A0Conquer is a loyal, devoted companion who isn't afraid to 'use his words' to tell you how he's feeling. If you have a heart for seniors and a love for a good success story, the 'Comeback Kid' is ready to prance into your forever home. ��%BD%A0Email for more info��%BD%

Description: CALIX WANTS A HOME!��%BD%A0 PLEASE FOSTER OR ADOPT TODAY!!!!��%BD%A0 ��%BD%A0Sweet 10-year young Calix is playful and friendly. He wants to be your snuggle bug in bed and best friend on your adventures and walks.��%BD%A0 Calix, aka Spooky #A2211880 from the north Central shelter deserves a happy ending! Did you follow his story on facebook or instagram? Apparently he was abused and neglected for years by his owners. A neighbor finally turned him into the shelter on July 25, 2025. Name: Callahan
Description: On January 12, 2026, we rescued Rocky,  #A4871718, now Callahan, from the Downey shelter. He is the 400th dog we have rescued since the inception of Golden years Dog Sanctuary in September of 2017!  Rocky. Now, Callahan, was owner surrendered to the Downy shelter on November 25, 2025. He was very friendly with people. According to his owner surrender notes he is good with other dogs and he received a good behavior assessment. We really need someone who can help us foster this dog or someone willing to adopt.

Name: Slauson
Description: Meet Slauson, an extraordinarily handsome young dog with the kindest eyes and the sweetest soul.  Slauson was saved from euthanasia and hes now ready for a loving home where he can finally feel safe and truly belong.  With his rich chocolate coat and warm tan markings, Slauson is striking but its his gentle, people-oriented nature that truly shines. He loves human connection and forms deep bonds, becoming incredibly loyal once trust is built. Though a bit nervous at first, he warms up quickly with patience and kindness.  Slauson is housetrained, crate-trained, and politely stays off the furniture. He knows basic commands, has great recall, and is completing a training program. Hes smart, eager to learn, and truly enjoys training and working for his food.  This soft-hearted boy will happily follow you from room to room, greet you like the best part of his day, and shower you with quiet devotion. Slauson would thrive in a calm home with a backyard and an adopter who enjoys continuing training. He would do best as an only dog or with a calm canine companion, and a home without young children is preferred.  If youre looking for a loyal, affectionate dog who will choose you every day, Slauson is ready to meet you.  http://instagram.com/adoptslauson/

Name: Benjamin (Benji)
Description: Benji is an awesome, sweet boy. But because of an upcoming surgery I will not be able to care for him properly. He does have gastrointestinal problems after eating certain dog treats.

Name: Roxy
Description: Roxy is available for adoption in Orange County!  This little gal joined us from the island of Kauai after spending 2 months sitting in an overcrowded shelter. At just 6 months of age, she weighs 25lbs. We are guessing she's some sort of Airedale/Irish terrier mix, likely with some hound in her.  Roxy is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and on flea/tick/HW medication.  This little gal is so sweet and friendly! She has yet to meet a stranger. She loves other dogs (although she's not the biggest fan of having them invade her space when she's eating), and playtime with her foster pup brothers and sisters is one of her favorite things. She rides well in the car, sleeps through the night in her crate, and appears to be housebroken in her foster home.  She is SMART, food motivated, and loves training. She is high energy, so she would do best in an active home that can get her plenty of exercise and continue working with her on her training. Physical and mental stimulation will be important for her!  She's going to be an absolutely incredible dog for a very lucky family. If you think you could be the furever home Roxy is looking for, please fill out an adoption application on our website!

Name: Zoe
Description: **Looking for a loving home for Zoe ��%90%BE**  My mother is entering hospice care, and we are sadly looking for a new home for her beloved **11-year-old Shih Tzu, Zoe**.  Zoe is very sweet and affectionate. She has **glaucoma and chronic dry eye**, which means she needs eye drops and ointment **three times a day**. She is currently **puppy-pad trained**, but she's smart and does signal when she wants to go outside when she stays with me.  Some adorable things about Zoe: �'ۢ She snores loudly for such a tiny dog (we joke she needs a little 'C-Pup') ���� �'ۢ She purrs like a happy pig when she's getting pets �'ۢ She snorts like a tiny truffle pig when hunting for treats ��%90�  She will be losing the person she's been closest to, so she needs **a patient and loving home** where she can be someone's companion again.  Please message me if you might be interested or know someone who could give Zoe a great home. Sharing is appreciated. ����

Name: Jewell
Description: Meet the dazzling 3-year-old Jewel, who found herself in a bit of a pickle when her only human sadly left this world. Suddenly, she was on the hunt for a new castle to call home! Her owner's best friend tried to step in, but let's just say the two tiny, grumpy dogs weren't exactly rolling out the welcome mat. Despite her world flipping upside down, Jewel's heart remains wide open-like a 24/7 all-you-can-eat buffet of love!  Jewel is the definition of sweet and affectionate. When she sees you, get ready for the full-body, chunky tail wag that could melt the iciest of hearts! You'll be treated to gentle nudges with her perfect paw, begging for just one more rub, or maybe a sweet angel kiss that'll make you feel like a million bucks.  She's the ultimate cuddle bug who's just as happy lounging around as she is strutting her stuff on a walk or playing like a puppy on a sugar rush. Jewel could totally thrive as your one-and-only fur baby, soaking up all that love, or she'd be equally thrilled with a couple of playful pals to share the spotlight. She's even managing just fine with her senior, grouchy foster brother, who knows just how to keep her in check when her excitement levels go through the roof!  And guess what? There hasn't been a single sign of aggression! The joy in her eyes when she gets attention tells a tale of a pup who hasn't always had the love she deserves.   Jewel is a true gem ready to shine in your family! She even shared her reign with her best cat buddy until she lost him to old age right before she lost her mom. Sure, she'll need a little training to polish up her manners, but she's all ears and eager to please.   So, if you're on the lookout for a joyful, affectionate snuggle buddy with the best wiggle butt in town-look no further! Jewel might just be the one to check off all your boxes! Jewel is happily fostered in the Redondo Beach area. Come meet her and you're sure to fall in love!

Name: Ziggy
Description: VIDEO INCLUDED! Everyone, meet Ziggy, our 4 year old American Bulldog mix. Isn't he handsome! Poor boy has been waiting patiently for a foster or a forever family to love him and welcome him home. Ziggy is very loving and affectionate to his family once he bonds with them. Actually,  he gets attached to a family quickly and will be protective of his humans, so it's best that he goes to a home with older children (middle school ages and up). Ziggy gets along well with other dogs after a proper introduction. No cats though. He loves to play! He loves to be near you and be your buddy! He is neutered, fully vaccinated and microchipped. Ziggy really needs this chance! Would you be interested in opening your home and your heart to this boy? Please contact me if you are. Adoption process needs to be 100% approved.

Description: Urgent Listed!!!! This stunning, 1 year old pup is in grave danger to being put on the Euthanasia List, if not adopted quickly!!!  Tony needs a hero!!!  TOBY, A2251894 - MALE, TAN AND BLACK CHINESE SHARPEI.  Shelter: NORTH CENTRAL Age: 1 YR, Weight: 64 LBS.  This animal has been at the shelter since 01/12/2026.

Name: Stormy
Description: URGENT FOSTER/ADOPTER NEEDED! Video included. In October, Stormy's world was turned upside down- her family, the only one she's ever known, was moving and could not take her or her Great Dane brother with them. After 6 years of love and loyalty, Stormy suddenly found herself abandoned and confused.  Stormy was with her family since she was just a 10-week-old puppy. She grew up with them, devoted her entire life to loving them, and now she's left behind. However, we have placed Stormy with a temporary foster. One of the videos we're sharing is from when she was a baby, showing her sassy 'talking'- the same sweet personality she still has today. About Stormy: Spayed. Dog Friendly: Has only lived with her Great Dane brother, got along beautifully with him. Cat Friendly: Has been around cats and shows no interest in them. Kid Friendly: Wonderful with kids, she's been around grandkids, friends, and neighbors.  Gentle, mellow, loving, and listens well. People Friendly: Loves everyone she meets, always ready for affection. Loves: Car rides, playing in water, and being sassy with her 'talking.'  Stormy is the sweetest soul- calm, affectionate, and so loyal. Her playful little 'conversations' will melt your heart. She is the kind of dog who just wants to be near her people, soaking up every ounce of love you have to give.  Stormy is looking for a new adoptive home.  Please, don't let her love and loyalty be repaid with heartbreak. Share her story. Open your heart. Be the one who shows her that she is still wanted, still cherished, still worthy. If you can help Stormy, please contact Jennifer with Pumpkin Pawz Rescue at (714) 366-8170 (text is best). Please share everywhere!

Name: Wendy
Description: Meet Wendy - Sweet, Adorable, and So Ready to Love You!   Wendy is a medium-energy girl who loves her daily walks and is always up for an adventure. On leash, she's very easy to handle. When she spots another dog- even across the street- she's interested and will stop to stare, her tail wagging the whole time. She's a friendly and curious gal!  At home, Wendy is incredibly affectionate and thrives on love and attention. Belly rubs are at the top of her favorite things list! She also loves settling down with a Kong filled with frozen peanut butter. While she does have a little separation anxiety, she sleeps peacefully in her own room for up to 10 hours at night without much fuss.  Wendy is potty trained and listens well when corrected. She's eager to please and responds beautifully to gentle guidance.  She's wonderful with people and is not shy at all - she's been great with kids and happily greets human strangers with her sweet nature. She's also doing great with her 13-year-old foster dog sibling, a mini dachshund, and seems genuinely interested in other dogs.  Wendy is ready to bring warmth, tail wags, and lots of cuddles into her forever home. If you're looking for a loving, loyal companion who will adore you as much as you adore her, Wendy might just be your girl!

Name: Xena
Description: URGENT FOSTER OR ADOPTER NEEDED FOR SWEET XENA! Everyone, please take a moment to meet Xena, our beautiful, loyal, and loving 8-year-old Pit Bull. For far too long now, Xena has been waiting patiently, quietly in a boarding facility. She doesn't know why she's there. She doesn't understand why no one has come for her. And it's breaking our hearts. But she can no longer stay in boarding and if she doesn't find a foster or adopter, she will be taken to a kill shelter. We can't let that happen! Xena isn't just any dog. She's a soulmate dog- the kind who forms deep bonds and gives her whole heart. She lives to love. She'll follow you around the house, snuggle beside you, and gaze into your eyes like you hung the moon. Her love is unwavering, loyal, and true. Xena thrives in a calm, secure home where she can feel safe and cherished. She may do best as the only pet, as she prefers a quiet environment and a peaceful routine. Boarding staff said she was a great dog.  She's silly and playful, and her snuggles will melt every hard day away. She gives her whole heart to the people she loves, and when she does, it's forever. She's not asking for much- just a chance. A soft bed. A gentle hand. A place to rest her head where she feels wanted, safe, and finally home. Please, we are desperately looking for a foster or adopter who can give Xena the loving, stable home she so deeply deserves. She's been so patient. She's been so brave. But her heart is growing heavy waiting for love. Can you be her hero? Can you give her the home she's been dreaming of the one she's never had?  Watch her video here and just see how special she is: https://youtu.be/3qtDiep9nWA?feature=shared.  Contact Pumpkin Pawz Rescue's Jennifer Newman at (714) 366-8170. Please reach out if you can help. Share her story. It takes a community to save lives, and Xena is counting on us. Let's not let her wait one more lonely day.

Name: Colette
Description: Meet Colette!  If we had to describe this darling Frenchie in three words: loving, grounded, joyful. And she truly lives up to every one of them.  Colette is incredibly affectionate and friendly with everyone she meets - no warm-up period required! She greets the world with a happy heart and a wagging spirit. Her energy level is medium, making her the perfect balance of playful and relaxed. She's just as content heading out for a nice walk as she is lounging near her people.  She is wonderful with other dogs and loves playing with her doggie foster siblings. On walks, she has no reaction when passing other dogs and may even try to make a new friend if encouraged. She's easy to handle on leash and very athletic, happily enjoying solo strolls or pack adventures.  Colette is very affectionate but not at all clingy. She simply loves being around the humans and animals in her home - a true social lady! Her favorite toys are nylabones and other hard chews, and she enjoys staying engaged and active.  Colette is currently healing from a sialoadenectomy (the mass on her neck is already much smaller after her surgery), and we're happy to share that nothing further is needed - she's recovering beautifully and is ready to find her forever home.  If you're looking for a steady, joyful companion who will bring warmth, friendliness, and just the right amount of playful energy into your life, Colette may be your perfect match.

Name: SIMBA
Description: Courtesy Posting:  PACIFICA, CA (N CAL, just south of SAN FRAN)- ADORABLE AND FRIENDLY, SMALLER 11 MO CHOW PUPPY 'SIMBA' WHO WAS RECENTLY RESCUED, AND NOW LOOKING FOR A FOREVER HOME, IDEALLY W PRIOR CHOW OR LONG TERM DOG EXPERIENCE - good with dogs, respectful kids Please help us find a  loving and forever home for dear Simba, who was rescued by a good Samaritan from a home who could no longer care for him due to the large number of dogs in the home.  Simba was originally malnourished, but is now 32 lbs and is expected to grow a bit larger as turns 1 year old in April. Simba has since been vaccinated, HW negative, and is being neutered March 6th. His foster tell us, 'Over the past several weeks, Simba has made tremendous progress. He has gained 10 healthy pounds (from 22 lbs to 32 lbs), is now in excellent physical condition, and has blossomed emotionally. He bonded with me within two weeks - he now asks for affection, sleeps in our bed, and follows me from room to room. He is house-trained, absolutely loves other dogs (very pack-oriented), and is good with children - shy but curious and gentle.' Additionally, she said, 'Simba is very shy and timid at first, but incredibly sweet, intelligent, and gentle. It took about two weeks for him to fully open up and begin seeking affection from me and my husband. He loves affection and will actively seek out pets. His favorite thing to do is sleep in our bed and diligently asks for morning snuggles. He takes food very gently from your hand. He loves other dogs and was raised with four children and four other dogs (5 total including him). He is curious but cautious with new people and children, and warms up much more quickly when allowed to approach at his own pace rather than being approached. He loves long exploratory walks and hikes.' 'He willingly leaves the apartment for walks but is hesitant to return inside because he does not want the walk to end. I sit down next to him and say, 'up, up' and gently pick him up to bring him back in.  He would thrive in a positive reinforcement home with a backyard and another confident dog. He shows no resource guarding of food or toys. He rides very well in the car, enjoys sitting on my lap. His energy level is calm and low inside the home, and higher outside where he enjoys sniffing and playing with other dogs. He is comfortable being left alone for a few hours at a time.' 'Simba is very shy and timid initially, but extremely gentle and sweet. He has never shown aggression EVER. He takes time to warm up and prefers to approach people at his own pace. If people ignore him initially, he becomes curious, sniffs, and gradually builds comfort. He warms up more quickly to people who have dogs. He takes longer to warm up to visitors who come without a dog present. Once comfortable, he is friendly with adults, children, and other dogs. He has not been tested with cats.' We have nice video of Simba interacting with his foster and showing how loving he can be, as well as with other dogs. He has no reported bites or medical issues, and lived previously in a home with other dogs and children. We are now looking for a chow and or dog savvy forever home who understands the breed, and also that puppies need continual training, to take precautions, and with chows,  proper socialization with others.  If you are interested in meeting and adopting Simba, please contact

Description: Meet Stetson!  He's got those Husky vibes and a really, really big heart.  Stetson is a people dog. Not in a flashy way. In a 'I just want to be near you' way. He'll sit by your feet. Follow you from room to room. Keep an eye on things like it's his quiet responsibility.  He's affectionate. Loyal. A little sensitive. He bonds hard. Once he decides you're his person, that's it - you're a team.  Shelter life isn't where he shines. It's loud. It's busy. And he's ready for something steadier. A couch. A routine. A yard. A human who's his.  He needs someone willing to show up for him. Someone who wants a dog who actually wants to be with them.  If you've been thinking about a companion - not just a dog, but a sidekick - Stetson might be your guy.  Let's get him out of the shelter and into a real life! Petey bonds hard and takes his relationships seriously, which means he can be a little clingy-but in the best, loyal-dog way. He's not into sharing the spotlight and would do best as an only dog where he can really shine.  He's smart, eager to learn, already knows sit and stay, and is working on his leash skills and confidence. With patience and consistency, he keeps getting better and more comfortable out in the world.  Petey would love an active home with a yard, a person who's down for adventures, and someone who wants a true sidekick. He's loving, loyal, and ready to be someone's favorite. Name: Jillian
Description: Jillian is a sweet girl. She goes by Jillian, Jilly, JillyBean, JellyBean and Bean.  She loves laying on the couch with you, loves snuggling up with a good blanket. She will get up close and personal while you're eating if you let her, and she's vocal about her wants.  She is trained to go on a potty pad, and also does well with regular, short walks. She will sleep in a crate overnight, or in your bed or near you on her bed.  She does not like being picked up very much, but she will tolerate it if necessary.  We have not been able to keep up with her shots due to economic hardship and domestic violence, but she is spayed.  She has only ever been around her sister and littermate, and they have recently started having issues with one another. She needs to be in a home where she is the only dog and she can get all the love and affection and cuddles she deserves.  Our situation is especially dire now as we experience homelessness and desperately want to find her a good home.

Name: MICKEY
Description: Hi, meet Mickey, a big 2yr old cutie weighing in at 65-70lbs. He has the most adorable floppy ears and light greenish hazel eyes and the sweetest personality. We're not sure his exact breeds but going by his looks and shelter description. Mickey loves people and dogs and plays very well with everyone. He's mostly great on the leash, pulls once in awhile on walks but his foster still thinks he's easy to walk and absolutely amazing. He impressed them on day 1 with how obedient he was. He knows sit, paw and down, so easily trainable. He is potty trained,  crate trained and overall,  a very good boy in the house. He was a staff favorite at the shelter but sadly due to overcrowding, his turn was finally up and our wonderful foster had to save him after meeting him so we wanted to help find this cutie a forever home. He would be a wonderful addition to your pack, a perfect bestie sidekick for life's adventures with you or an amazing family dog that will brighten everyday and make you smile with his expressions and his 1 floppy ear! Mickey is one of those 1 in a million dogs that is just perfect! Sadly, so many great dogs are euthanized for space but Mickey was saved for a special reason, was he saved for you? Mickey is neutered, vaccinated and will be chipped soon. You can foster to adopt or adopt our special boy! Get your application in ASAP for the best boy, Mickey!

Name: Chef
Description: Chef is an incredibly healthy sweet loving English bulldog that has been with us since he was six weeks old. He does not do well with children although he loves my son very much as he's known him since birth and is very tolerant of a 2 1/2 year-old. However, any other kids is a hard no. He does great with little dogs, but big dogs are hit or miss. He absolutely despises, huskies and shepherds or any dogs with husky looking eyes. It's best to keep him away from big dogs in general. He's super active for a seven year-old bulldog. He has a ton of energy. He loves to play, run, fetch, tug-of-war, wrestle, anything- you name it. He is very high energy for a 75 pound English bulldog of seven years old. If you are looking for a lazy couch potato, he's not it but he does know how to cuddle up and sleep throughout the day. I'm recently separated, a single mother and a business owner and I just do not have the time or money to give him the life he deserves anymore. I truly want him to go to a home that will give him the love and attention he craves and deserves. He is such a good boy and I love him so much, but there's only so much I can do alone nowadays.

Name: Max
Description: URGENT FOSTER/ADOPTER NEEDED: Meet Maxwell (Max) Your Future Best Friend! Say hello to Maxwell, a 3-year-old Golden Retriever mix with a heart as golden as his coat! Max's journey is one of resilience and love. Once rescued from Lancaster Animal Care Center, he quickly became a staff favorite, charming everyone with his gentle spirit and joyful personality. Now thriving in professional training, Max continues to impress! He's incredibly smart, well-mannered, and eager to please. Walks beautifully on leash. Knows all his basic commands. Takes treats gently and patiently.  Loves toys, balls, and playtime. Gets along well with other dogs. Max enjoys structure and routine, and he truly shines in a calm, loving environment. Once he builds trust, he's wonderfully affectionate. A loyal companion who'll melt your heart with every wag of his tail. With his easygoing personality (the Golden in him definitely shows!), Max is ready to bring endless love, laughter, and warmth to his forever home. If you're ready to meet this special boy and make him part of your family, please contact Jennifer at +1 (714) 366-8170 (text preferred) with Pumpkin Pawz Rescue. Let's help Max find the forever home he's been waiting for one filled with love, fun, and new adventures!

Name: Teddy
Description: URGENT: Teddy Desperately Needs a Foster or Forever Home A very special German Shepherd named Teddy is in a heartbreaking situation and urgently needs our help. Teddy was purchased as a Christmas gift (which is never a good idea) for two young children when they were just 5 and 1 years old. The kids are now 11 and 8, and their mother is no longer in their lives. Their grandmother, Ana, took full custody of both the children and Teddy. Sadly, she can no longer care for him financially or provide the space and attention he needs. Heartbreakingly, the family recently purchased a Poodle, leaving Teddy forgotten and neglected. Don't get me started! Teddy spends every day confined to a small outdoor kennel in the backyard with little to no attention only let out to relieve himself before being put right back inside. No dog deserves to live like this. The grandmother considered taking him to the pound but fears he will be euthanized. She wants better for him but doesn't know what else to do. Teddy is a 6-year-old neutered, well-behaved, and gentle giant who loves people. He gets along with other dogs and, despite losing half of his right ear in a dog attack at 8 weeks old, carries no emotional scars. He is sweet, resilient, and simply yearning for love. Please, open your heart to Teddy. He deserves more than a life in a kennel. He deserves affection, freedom, adventure, and a family that truly cares for him. If you can foster, foster-to-adopt, or adopt, please contact Jennifer with Pumpkin Pawz Rescue at +1 (714) 366-8170 (text preferred). Teddy is waiting. Don't let him spend another day forgotten. The pictures you see outside of the kennel was taken during his bathroom break; otherwise, he is always inside the outside kennel. Day and night in all kinds of weather.

Name: Boo Boo
Description: VIDEO INCLUDED: MEET BOO BOO: THE LITTLE LOVEBUG WHO STOLE OUR HEARTS! Hi friends, please help us share this precious girl far and wide! Boo Boo got her adorable name because she arrived to her loving foster home on Halloween in 2024 and ever since, she's been spreading sweetness like candy! She's an approximately 7-year-old female Pomeranian mix who's truly a gentle, joyful soul looking for her forever family. ALL ABOUT BOO BOO: The SWEETEST, most LOVING little girl. Obsessed with belly rubs- she'll roll over and smile every time. Loves to chase a ball (even if she doesn't always bring it back).  Big fan of car rides, the windows down, ears flapping kind! And yes, she LOVES McDonald's chicken sandwiches. Boo Boo has so much love to give, and she deserves a home where she can be cherished and adored every single day. She's low maintenance, affectionate, and full of charm- the perfect companion. If you're interested in giving Boo Boo the forever home she deserves, please TEXT Jennifer at Pumpkin Pawz Rescue: (714) 366-8170. Text is best! PLEASE SHARE with your friends, family, and social media circles. It takes a village to help sweethearts like Boo Boo find their happily ever after.

Name: Saffron
Description: VIDEO INCLUDED: Everyone, meet beautiful girl, Saffron. Saffron is a lovely, young and petite Pit Bull. She is approx 3 years old. She is a death row shelter survivor, being rescued just hours before she was scheduled to be euthanized. She is a very special girl!! She longs to be loved and to have a close bond with the humans in her life. After spending two years in a boarding facility, she finally has a loving foster family. She is now in a home environment, surrounded by love, security, fun and play. Saffron can be a little shy at first, when meeting new people, but she warms up pretty quickly, once she feels safe and loved. She is good with other dogs- big and small. She is so cute to watch her try to play and engage with other dogs. Saffron enjoys going on walks, getting love and affection from her humans (she gives the most gentle kisses), and she delights in the indulgence of her favorite yummy treats! Saffron is absolutely precious!! She longs to have a forever home and forever family of her own. Would you be willing to open your home and your heart to this sweet angel and give her a loving forever home? Adoption process needs to be 100% approved.

Name: Ginger
Description: URGENT FOSTER/ADOPTER NEEDED! Video included. Ginger's life was filled with heartbreak and neglect, but despite everything, she remains the sweetest, most loving soul. This beautiful 3-year-old German Shepherd used to live in the high desert, locked in a dog run 24/7 and had no shelter from the scorching desert sun or freezing nights, no fresh water in her bucket, and barely enough food to survive. She was very thin. She lived among filth and trash and her own feces, deplorable conditions, yet when Jennifer arrived, Ginger greeted her with kisses and love, desperate for even the smallest bit of kindness. She was so grateful when Jennifer filled her water bucket. Her caramel-colored eyes tell a story of longing, longing for food, warmth, affection, and a family who truly cares.  Ginger is currently safe in boarding, she knows how to sit on command, adores toys, and was eager for the treats Jennifer had, a heartbreaking reminder of how little she was given. Ginger loves meeting new people and she is friendly from the moment she meets you. Ginger deserves safety, warmth, full meals, and a family who will love and cherish her. Name: Ella
Description: Meet Ella ��%90%BE  Ella is a stunning German Shepherd, about 6 years old, with a sparkle that's impossible to miss. Everyone agrees the only reason she waited so long at the shelter was because she's missing some fur on her tummy-but honestly, we hardly notice it. All we see is her joyful, affectionate personality shining through.  Ella is incredibly friendly, smart, and highly trainable. She has the energy of a much younger dog (the vet says closer to a 2-year-old!) and loves long walks, adventures, and exploring the world by your side. She's also a top-tier cuddler and very affection-seeking once the fun is done.  She's house trained, crate trained, walks beautifully on a leash, and does great with kids, cats, and other dogs. Her missing tummy fur may never grow back, but it's not contagious and doesn't bother her one bit.  After spending months at the shelter with no interest, Ella finally got her second chance and is now living the spoiled life in a loving foster home. She's ready to bring her big heart, bright spirit, and endless love to her forever family.

Description: Meet Guerro ��ջ��%90%BE - strength of a superhero, heart of a total goober  If you've ever wondered what would happen if The Hulk had the personality of a lovable doofus�'�| meet Guerro.  Guerro is about 2 years old, 60 pounds, and built like a tank - pure muscle and very strong. But don't let the brawn fool you. Beneath that tough exterior is a sweet, silly, people-loving cuddle bug who just wants pets, affection, and to be included in whatever you're doing.  He's friendly with people and has a goofy charm that wins hearts fast. With other dogs, Guerro does well with proper, slow introductions and polite handling. He appears to be house-broken, rides great in the car, and once you arrive at your destination - patio restaurant, brewery, dog park, you name it - he's calm, happy, and soaking up the vibes like a pro.  Now, full disclosure: Guerro is very pully on leash, so he'll need a strong, confident handler who's ready to work on leash manners and channel all that power appropriately. Think Hercules strength with Scooby-Doo energy - big muscles, zero bad intentions, lots of lovable nonsense.  ��%8F� Ideal home for Guerro:  Active household  Secure yard to stretch those powerful legs  Someone who appreciates a big, blocky pit bull mix with a soft heart  A human who wants both an adventure buddy and a cuddle partner   Guerro is proof that big pit bull mixes aren't scary - they're sweet, affectionate, goofy, and deeply loyal. If you're looking for a strong boy with a gentle soul and a whole lot of personality, Guerro might just be your perfect match.  Ready to meet your new favorite goober?

Name: Merlin
Description: Meet Merlin!   Merlin is a 6-month-old Doberman mix with a big heart and an even bigger sense of adventure. At around 40 lbs and growing, this sweet boy is the perfect blend of playful puppy energy and cuddle-ready affection.  Merlin is incredibly bright and eager to learn-he already knows how to sit and come when called! His recall is impressive. He's curious about the world and loves being right by your side, whether you're heading out for a walk, a hike, or a beach day. Water is one of his favorite things, and he's always up for exploring new sights and smells.  He's pack-oriented and very friendly with other dogs, wonderful with kids, and absolutely adores people. Merlin is very motivated by affection and thrives on love and attention. When the adventure winds down, he's happiest cuddled up close.  Merlin is house-trained, crate trained, and does especially well with potty training in a home with a yard. He's ready to settle into a forever home where he can continue learning, playing, and loving.  If you're looking for a loyal, adventurous, and incredibly sweet and smart companion, Merlin might just be your perfect match.

Name: Delilah
Description: Meet Delilah ����  Delilah is a 10-month-old sweetheart with the softest soul and the most hopeful eyes. Her life didn't start out easy-she was found as a stray and ended up in a high-kill shelter-but thanks to rescue, she now has a second chance at the life she's always deserved.  It's clear Delilah never had the opportunity to explore the world before. Walks, baths, and new experiences were all brand new to her-but she has handled everything with such grace. She did amazing at her very first puppy wash, soaking up the attention and showing just how gentle and trusting she truly is.  Delilah has a peaceful, tender heart and a soft, loving personality. She's incredibly gentle, does wonderfully meeting new people, and wins hearts everywhere she goes. She adores pup cups, enjoys being close to her people, and prefers to sleep in the same room as you, finding comfort simply being nearby.  She has a mastiff-type build without the towering height of a Great Dane-strong yet elegant, calm yet curious. Delilah is looking for a family who will patiently show her the world, introduce her to new adventures, and spoil her the way every dog should be spoiled.  She has her entire life ahead of her, and she's ready to fill it with love, security, and joyful firsts.  ���� If you're looking for a gentle, loving companion who will blossom with guidance and kindness, Delilah may be your perfect match.

Name: Turbo
Description: Turbo is a 5-year-old, 11-pound Chihuahua mix with a short tan coat, adorable short little legs, and the cutest underbite that gives him an irresistibly charming smile. This little gentleman may be slightly shy when meeting someone new, but give him a moment and he'll quickly become your devoted shadow. Once he warms up, his affectionate and loving personality truly shines.  Turbo is the perfect blend of confidence and sweetness. He's fantastic with other dogs and thrives in a pack setting. On leash, he's a good boy - no pulling, just happily trotting by your side. He's also a dream in the car, making him an ideal travel buddy for weekend getaways or daily errands.  At home, Turbo is fully house-trained and sleeps soundly in his crate at night. He has lovely manners - sitting patiently and waiting to go in and out of doors. While he enjoys perching on the back of the couch for a cozy solo nap, his favorite place in the world is curled up in your lap or flipped onto his back for belly rubs. He absolutely loves being carried and soaking up all the affection you're willing to give.  Turbo is neutered, up to date on vaccines, and ready to bring joy, companionship, and lots of cuddles to his forever home. If you're looking for a sweet, smart, affectionate little companion who will happily be your sidekick wherever you go, Turbo might just be your perfect match.

Description: Blue is an almost 3 year old miniature dachshund and is so loved. This is a very difficult decision to rehome him, but I know that it would be best for him. Name: SCHNITZEL
Description: Meet Schnitzel.  He's a 10-week-old Shepherd/Aussie mix with soft ears, wiggly energy, and a serious love for cuddles. A good Samaritan found him alone at a park, and now he's ready for a real home - the kind where he doesn't have to wonder what's next.  Schnitzel is sweet, playful, and very into his people. He loves to snuggle, does well with cats, and is happiest when he's included in whatever's going on. He's still a baby, so he's learning the world one new thing at a time. A confident dog friend or a patient family would help him build that confidence even more.  He is working through some food guarding, which likely comes from not always feeling secure. The upside? He's already responding well to routine and positive training. With consistency, he's showing he can relax and trust that his needs will be met.  He's not a 'plug-and-play' puppy - he's a real one. But the person who gives him structure and love now is going to end up with an incredibly loyal, fun, and devoted dog.

Name: LANCELOT
Description: Meet Lancelot ��'ە�%8F  He's a 9-week-old Hound/Pit mix who came to us from Palms N Paws after being found as a stray in 29 Palms. He may be small, but he's already showing he's a pretty brave little guy.  He powered through his first bath like a champ. Car rides? They make him a tiny bit queasy - but he's working on it. Baby steps. He's still just a pup figuring things out.  Lancelot is sweet, wiggly, and very into people. He loves attention and will happily climb into your lap the second you sit down. If you're petting him, you're doing it right.  He's at that fun puppy stage - curious, cuddly, and ready to learn. All he needs now is a family who's excited for the puppy adventures ahead (and doesn't mind a little chaos along the way).  He's ready to head home and start being someone's very favorite dog.

Name: OATMEAL
Description: Meet Oatmeal. Approx 20 pounds.  She's a 7-year-old miniature poodle who was found in Lucky Park and brought in by 29 Palms Animal Control before making her way to us.  When she arrived, it was clear she hadn't been cared for in a long time. Her coat was badly matted. Her nails had grown into her paw pads. She was scared and unsure - and honestly, who wouldn't be?  Right now, Oatmeal is still figuring out that she's safe. She's wary of handling and needs someone who understands that trust doesn't come overnight. She'll need a patient, gentle home willing to move at her pace and let her set the timeline.  The good news? Even in her fear, there's a softness there. She wants to feel safe. She just doesn't know how yet.  With slow introductions, steady kindness, and someone who won't rush her, Oatmeal has every chance to bloom.  She's a little dog who's had a hard stretch and deserves a soft landing.

Name: QUINOA
Description: Meet Quinoa.  She's 1 year old, 10 pounds, and absolutely convinced the world is interesting.  Quinoa came to us from Palms N Paws after being picked up as a stray, and she's handled the whole thing like a champ. She's curious, friendly, and always checking things out like, 'Okay�'�| what are we doing next?'  She gets along well with other dogs and would be happy with a buddy, but she'd also be perfectly content being your little sidekick. She's the kind of dog who's easy to bring along - small enough to scoop up, big enough personality that you won't forget she's there.  She's got that fun, alert Chihuahua energy without being over the top. Just a bright little dog who wants to be part of whatever you're doing.  If you're looking for a tiny dog who's down for life - errands, couch time, road trips, backyard hangs - Quinoa's ready.

Description: THE DOG BELOW IS A COURTESY LISTING. THE DOG IS NOT IN OUR CARE. This dog is being rehomed by their owner. This sweet soul was pulled from a kill shelter just hours before he was scheduled to be euthanized-and now he's ready for a second chance at life with someone who sees the beauty in a shy dog learning to trust again. Indoors, he's calm and allows gentle affection; outside, he still prefers to keep a little distance, but never tries to run away.  He's crate trained, potty trained, and even familiar with pee pads. Zorro gets along beautifully with other dogs, big and small, and would love to have a confident canine buddy to show him the ropes. He hasn't been tested with cats, but based on his gentle demeanor, we suspect he'd be just fine.  Zorro isn't a barker-just a soft communicator who might let out a woof when he wants to go outside. He's also strong and muscular, so a home that can provide him with daily walks and gentle structure will help him thrive.  Above all, Zorro needs a patient, kind-hearted human who can give him the time and space to bloom. If you've got a calm home, a gentle touch, and a soft spot for the underdog-Zorro just might be your soulmate. Name: Nala
Description: Here's what the humans have to say about me:  Meet Nala! She is a beautiful, super sweet, goofy, playful seven-month-old puppy who loves to zoom and leap over everything (including other dogs)! She was rescued from the streets, so she needs a home where she can be supervised indoors while being outside in a secure, puppy-proof backyard, as she loves to go under fences and through holes. We believe Nala is half Italian greyhound, so she can run really fast! Sweet Nala is full of love and will knock you down to give you kisses and stick her whole head in your shirt and her nose in your ear and just smother you with love. When she tires herself out, she will fall asleep with her head on your shoulder. She has long legs like a baby deer and is a distinguished looking little lady. Although she weighs almost 30 pounds, Nala thinks she is tiny and loves to cuddle in your lap. She is energetic and loves to play, so she would do well with another non-aggressive dog. Once she trusts the other dog, she will play nonstop. Nala is still a puppy and loves to chew on everything, so she needs plenty of chew toys to keep her busy chewing on healthy objects. The puppy in her makes her want to chase cats so she is probably best in a home with no cats. Nala is still working on her leash skills. She is crate-trained and will go potty outside if you take her regularly; she is also pee pad trained when indoors. If you are looking for a loving, enthusiastic, energetic young dog, then Nala just might be your girl!  Loved Again Pets

But Dixie isn't just cute-she's also a strong personality who needs an experienced dog owner to guide her. When she knows who's in charge, she thrives! Without clear boundaries, she can become a bit unpredictable. So if you have dog experience and love the idea of a smart, spirited companion, Dixie is your girl. She wants to be your one-and-only pet (no other dogs or cats, please!) so she can have all your attention. If your home includes children, they must be teenagers or older, as Dixie prefers a calm environment. She's not fully potty trained yet but does great with pee pads, and with consistency and patience, she'll keep improving. If you're ready to lead with confidence and love, Dixie will reward you with endless devotion, playtime, and plenty of Pomeranian sass. Description: Osita is a 5 year old, 55 lb Pit Bull mix with a big heart and a very healthy respect for personal space.  Let's talk about 'bubbles' for a second...You know, personal space. The kind we all appreciate.  Osita feels the same way.  She is not reactive and can calmly pass other dogs on walks or while out and about, but she does not want to share her home or her personal space with other animals. No small dogs, no big dogs, no cats, and no critters. And honestly? That's okay. Some of us prefer a quiet, peaceful home too.  What Osita does love is people. She adores attention, enjoys meeting new humans, and is friendly with anyone she crosses paths with, even if they're outside her 'bubble.' (meaning strangers). She's affectionate without being overwhelming and has strong cat-energy in the best way: independent, observant, and deeply loyal to her people...though if a stranger has a yummy treat in hand then she will be loyal to them!  Kids, however, are just too much for her. They're loud, unpredictable, and don't always understand boundaries. So Osita is looking for an adult-only home where things stay calm and respectful.  No, she is certainly not for everyone, but she is perfect for someone. She's an absolute dream for the right lifestyle. Osita loves walks, hikes, car rides, outings, and lunch dates. She's confident in public and makes an excellent adventure buddy. She do

Name: Lola Jane
Description: Lola Jane is a gorgeous 40 lb Dutch Shepherd mix with a gentle heart, and soulful eyes. She struts a beautiul brindle coat and those ears can hear you call her a good girl from a mile away. She's a little shy when meeting new people, but once she feels safe, her sweet and loving nature shines through.  Lola Jane adores other dogs and is learning that the world isn't such a scary place after all. She's blossoming more every day, showing her playful side and enjoying her walks as she gains confidence.  If you're looking for a kind, loyal companion who just needs a little patience and a lot of love, Lola Jane is the perfect match.  Est DOB 1/1/25

Name: Lucy Goosey
Description: Lucy Goosey is the sweetest little Shepherd mix with a heart full of love! She might be a bit shy at first, but once she warms up, her gentle, affectionate personality shines through.  Lucy is doing wonderfully with her leash training and loves spending time with her doggy friends. She's playful, kind, and learning that the world is a pretty fun (and safe!) place to explore.  If you're looking for a loving companion who just needs a little patience and a lot of snuggles, Lucy Goosey is your girl!  Est DOB 1/1/25

Name: Hazel Mae
Description: Hazel is may be a shy girl in the streets but she's certainly a certified boober at home! Hazel is a delicate little soul with two very distinct personalities... and both are absolutely SO sweet!  Personality #1: When Hazel first meets new people, she's very, very shy. On outings, she's calm, quiet, and perfectly content to blend into the background. She's not here to steal the spotlight and she's happy to go unnoticed, observe the world softly, and mind her own business like a tiny introvert queen.  Personality #2 though... Goober: Level 100! Once Hazel feels safe and comfortable? Oh boy. At home, she transforms into a playful, silly, affectionate little goober girl. She loves cuddling on the couch, soaking up sunshine in the yard, and watching butterflies glide by like it's her favorite TV show. She'll make you laugh, melt into you for snuggles, and remind you just how special it is to earn a shy dog's trust.  Hazel is also house trained, crate trained (does great for a few hours at a time), a professional cuddler once she knows you, and a total doll with the right patience and love  Hazel isn't a 'love at first sight' kind of girl but she's a love that grows deeper every day. If you're willing to give her a little time and grace at the beginning, she'll reward you with endless affection, quiet loyalty, and top-tier goober energy once she's home.  If you've ever wanted to be someone's safe place, Hazel might just be your girl.  Hazel is 1 year old and weighs about 45 lbs!

Name: Pookie Bear
Description: Pookie Bear (or just Pookie) is a 3 year old sweetheart who is AMAZING with people, kids, and other dogs. He's the definition of a gentle, social, lovable companion who wants nothing more than to be part of a family.  Despite his big, cuddly name, Pookie is all softness and charm. He greets everyone with a happy spirit, a wagging tail, and the kind of sweetness that melts your heart instantly. He's currently working on his leash training and doing great! He's eager to learn, eager to please, and always trying his best.  If you're looking for a kind, friendly, loving dog who fits beautifully into just about any home, Pookie Bear is your guy. He's ready to bring joy, snuggles, and warm fuzzy feelings to his forever family.

Name: Ruby
Description: Ruby may be 9 years young, but you'd truly never know it. She's full of pep, joy, and sweetness. She knows her basic commands and is doing great learning to walk calmly on leash, proving that age is just a number. Ruby enjoys playing with other dogs (even the big ones) and absolutely adores snuggle time. She's only 44 lbs and is just as happy curling up next to you as she is relaxing in her own bed when she wants a little space.  Ruby sleeps peacefully through the night in her crate and is comfortable spending a few hours there during the day. She loves lounging in the backyard, soaking up the sunshine, and enjoys a good treat (or two!). True to her years, she has excellent house manners and doesn't chew on things she shouldn't.  Whoever is lucky enough to adopt Ruby will truly be hitting the jackpot. She's affectionate, easygoing, and ready to bring so much love into her forever home.

Name: Robbin
Description: Robbin is a happy, outgoing puppy with a heart as big as her personality. This girl is confident, social, and truly believes everyone she meets is already her friend. She loves playtime, toys, and exploring the world around her with curiosity and excitement.  Robbin enjoys being around people, does wonderfully with other dogs, and would thrive in a home with kids and even cats. She's eager to learn, enjoys positive reinforcement, and will benefit from continued training and socialization as she grows.  Robbin is the kind of puppy who will grow into a well-rounded, affectionate family dog and one who's always ready for adventure, playtime, and snuggles at the end of the day.  Est DOB 10/17/25

Name: Cali
Description: Cali is an absolutely beautiful girl with a heart of gold and a whole lot of love to give. She's sweet, social, and affectionate when she is with her family and at home, and while she can be shy at first with strangers (especially in her home) or in busy environments, a treat and a few moments of kindness are all it takes for her to warm right up and become your new best friend.  Cali is a smart girl who already knows commands like sit, down, and come. She walks well on leash, is house trained, crate trained, and rides nicely in the car (though she may get a little car sick from time to time). She loves attention, enjoys meeting people, and is great with kids.  She truly shines in active environments. Cali loves other dogs, enjoys the dog park, and would thrive in a home with another playful canine companion or a family committed to daily walks, adventures, and maybe even hikes. She's playful, outgoing, and brings joy wherever she goes.  If you're looking for a loving, fun, and loyal companion who's ready to be part of your everyday life, Cali is ready to meet you!!  Est DOB 3/9/25

Name: Cassian
Description: Cassian is playful, goofy, and full of life. He loves romping around with his siblings and enjoys every moment of puppyhood. He's outgoing, social, and happiest when he's part of the action. Cassian will be a fantastic fit for a family looking for an energetic, loving dog to grow up alongside them.  Est DOB 11/21/25

Name: Jake
Description: URGENT FOSTER/ADOPTER NEEDED! TWO VIDEO LINKS INCLUDED! Meet Jake, the Irresistible Pittie with a Dash of Hilarity! Jake has been stuck in boarding for two long years, waiting for his forever home. He's been through so much and deserves a family of his own, where he can finally feel safe and loved.  Jake needs to be the only dog in the home, but he's all the love and joy you'll need! His personality is one-of-a-kind- his zoomies are the cutest, as he spins in tight little circles, full of excitement. And when you're sitting down, he loves to nudge his face through your legs like a little ottoman, showing how much he craves closeness.  Jake is more than just a survivor- he's a wiggly bundle of joy who can't resist leaning in for those heartwarming pets. But here's the fun twist, he's got a hilarious side too! Jake's legendary zoomies will leave you in stitches and brighten up your days.  Here's why Jake is the perfect addition to your family: Jake is overflowing with love and affection. His heartwarming, wiggly greetings will melt your heart. But wait, there's more! Jake's zoomies are the stuff of legends. When he bursts into those playful, lightning-fast sprints, you won't be able to hold back your laughter. Jake's friendly nature extends to being a pro at obedience. He responds to commands, comes when called, and is great on leash. He's not just a joy to be around, he's a well-mannered companion. Jake's guilty pleasure? Starbucks puppuccinos! He knows how to savor the finer things in life. At approximately 3 years old and housebroken, Jake is the perfect size to fit into your heart and home. He's longing for a chance at a happy, pain-free life, and he truly deserves it.  Jake has so many adorable quirks that make him special, and his fun, loving nature will bring endless joy to any home. He's waited far too long, please help him find the family he's been longing for by sharing his story.  If you're ready to make Jake's dreams come true by offering him a loving home filled with heartwarming pets and endless laughter from his zoomies, please get in touch with Jennifer Newman with Pumpkin Pawz Rescue at 1(714) 366-8170. Rest assured, our adoption process ensures a 100% match to guarantee Jake's happiness in his forever home. Don't miss the opportunity to change Jake's life and let him fill your home with love and hilarity!  2ND VIDEO LINK: https://youtu.be/9knPlIHFnEQ

Name: Luca
Description: Meet Luca, a striking 1 1/2 year old Shepherd/Husky mix with the most mesmerizing blue eyes. Luca's Story: Found wandering loose at the corner of Nandina and Cole Ave in Riverside, Luca had been surviving alone for four days, narrowly avoiding traffic and coyotes. He was terrified but accepted treats from our hands, hinting at the gentle soul within. Despite multiple rescue attempts, it took professional trainer Nathalie and her team two hours to finally catch him- using patience, skill, and pure determination. Exhausted, Luca finally laid down and surrendered to safety. With no chip or ID, we suspect he was dumped, yet he remained in the same spot, faithfully waiting for an owner who never came. What Makes Luca So Special: Gentle & Sweet: Initially shy, Luca warms up quickly once he feels safe. He loves to be petted. Good on Leash: He walks nicely and is already crate trained. Well-Mannered: Luca learned to sit on command and comes when called, showcasing his sweet, submissive nature. Social & Non-Reactive: He's non-reactive around other dogs and adapts well to new people. Resilient Spirit: Despite a rough start, he's laid back and ready to embrace a life filled with love and care. His foster says he's no trouble at all. Luca is up-to-date on vaccines, chipped, and neutered. He needs a forever home- a safe place where he can feel secure and blossom into the loving companion he truly is.  Will you be the one to give Luca the security and love he deserves? If you have room in your heart and home to offer Luca, please contact Jennifer with Pumpkin Pawz Rescue at +1 (714) 366-8170 (text is best). Please share this post everywhere and help us find him the forever home he needs. Thank you for your kindness and support!

Name: Dylan
Description: VIDEO LINK INCLUDED: In January, this sweet, gentle boy's world fell apart and he was taken to a shelter where his furry sister was adopted without him.   Dylan is a male Mastiff mix. SO incredibly handsome. Gentle, sweet soul. Takes treats softly and politely. Loves yummy snacks. Rides great in the car. Despite everything he's been through, he is still loving, still kind, still trusting. He deserves warmth, safety, and a family who won't leave him behind again.  If you want to adopt Dylan, please contact Jennifer with Pumpkin Pawz Rescue at (714) 366-8170. PHOTOS & VIDEOS: https://myalbum.com/album/GL4z8GxmiB3knT/

Name: Gunner
Description: URGENT: Gunner Needs a Foster or Forever Home by FEBRUARY 28th! Meet Gunner: Certified Goofball & Heart-Melter. This handsome hunk is Gunner, a 4-year-old American Bulldog mix with a heart of gold and the comedic timing of a stand-up pro. Gunner urgently needs a new foster or forever home. His current foster is selling her home and moving, and Gunner must have placement secured by February 28th. Gunner came to us after his devoted human, who was unhoused, was incarcerated. Now he's ready for a new chapter filled with belly rubs, snacks, and toys. SO MANY TOYS. This boy is LOADED with personality! He keeps us laughing daily with his silly expressions, zoomie sprints, and dramatic 'I deserve another treat' performances. He's: Sweet as sugar. Goofy as heck. Ridiculously photogenic. Obsessed with his toy collection. A total snack connoisseur. Gunner would prefer to be your one and only pet- more love (and snacks) just for him! Please help us save Gunner. If you can foster, foster-to-adopt, or adopt, please reach out ASAP to Jennifer at Pumpkin Pawz Rescue: (714) 366-8170 (text is best). Let's find this sweet soul the safe, loving home he deserves. Please share. Time is critical.

Name: Cleo
Description: CLEO NEEDS A FOSTER OR ADOPTER BY FEBRUARY 28TH OR SHE HAS NOWHERE TO GO! Cleo didn't choose this life. She wandered into a stranger's yard- thin, exhausted, and clearly surviving on her own for far too long. No chip. No collar. No one looking for her. She was left behind and now she is facing being displaced again. Her current foster can no longer keep her because she is moving and without a foster or adopter secured by FEBRUARY 28TH, Cleo will have nowhere safe to go. We are running out of time for this girl. Cleo is a 2.5-year-old Shepherd mix with the sweetest, most loving heart. Loves being petted and close to her people. Smart and eager to please. Knows to sit. Walks nicely on leash. Housebroken. Does well with dogs her size with proper introductions. Absolutely adores people. She is ready to love someone with her whole heart. She just needs someone to give her that chance. This is critical. We urgently need a committed foster, foster-to-adopt, or adopter who can step up before the deadline. Cleo deserves warmth, safety, and stability- not another uncertain future. Please if you have room in your home and heart, step forward NOW. Contact Jennifer with Pumpkin Pawz Rescue immediately at (714) 366-8170 (text is best). Time is running out. February 28th is coming fast. PLEASE SHARE. EVERY SHARE COULD SAVE HER LIFE. It truly takes a village. Let's not let Cleo down! SECOND VIDEO: https://youtu.be/4n546tRbWTo?feature=shared

Name: XILO
Description: Weight  - 52lbs  This senior loves people but needs to be the only 4 legged child. He needs not a lot other than your attention. He is looking for a foster home that will provide a couch, love, attention and alot of snacks. We pay for medical and needs.

Name: Salem
Description: Hello, the dog I have described is my lovely dachshund/Jack Russel Terrier mix. Unfortunately due to life changes I am unable to keep her, and I am rehoming her for 125 to make sure she gets to a good home. Please reach out to me for more information, thank you.

Name: GENEVIEVE
Description: Weight 48 lbs  Genevieve is very playful, now working on her obedience training. She is extremely people friendly and loves to hang out, go for long walks

Description: NOTE: This is a courtesy post. If you are interested in adopting Theo, please email us and we will put you in touch with his current caretaker.  Adopt Theo! ��%90%BE  He is a 65 lb neutered male, pitsky mix. 5 yrs old and up to date on all vaccinations.  The perfect mix of calm and playful, this darling boy is being fostered by me after tragically losing his owner in a car accident. He checks all the boxes:  - Potty, leash, and crate trained - Gentle with kids - Great with other dogs (though he will love being the solo dog and soak up all the attention!) - Beach lover and hiking buddy - Doesn't like cats :(  Theo is that dog who wants to be a part of the action - whether it is a single person looking for their best friend or a family with kids who needs a playful shadow. Name: Oso
Description: Rescue Me photo upload isn't work so email me and I can send you photos of Oso.  Oso is a 6-year-old tricolor Corgi mix neutered male.  He weighs about 32 lbs. and is current on shots and microchipped.  He was rescued from the San Pedro Harbor Shelter and is housebroken and good with small dogs.  Not good with kids or large dogs.  Available to a family that has experience with corgis. So, if adopter has visiting grandkids that also would not be ideal.   He enjoys toys and does require some leash work as he pulls.  Oso is great with small dogs, both genders, is a happy camper in his foster home and we are looking for an adoptive home preferably in the Southbay area of Los Angeles or LA or OC Counties.  Will consider other areas.  However, an adopter would need to complete a pre adopt ap, do a meet/greet in the Southbay area (Torrance) and we would have a homeck done either by me or a colleague.
